description: This is a route definition file for managing 'posts' in a social media application using Express.js. It defines various endpoints for creating, deleting, retrieving, and interacting with posts, including comments and likes, with validation and authentication middleware.

methods.name: router.post
methods.description: Defines endpoint for creating a new post with validation of request body.

methods.name: router.delete
methods.description: Defines endpoint for deleting a post by ID.

methods.name: router.get
methods.description: Defines multiple endpoints for retrieving posts by ID, user, feed, explore, search, and comments with appropriate validation.

methods.name: router.post (comments)
methods.description: Defines endpoint for commenting on a post.

methods.name: router.post/delete (like/unlike)
methods.description: Defines endpoints for liking and unliking a post.
